summary: Fix graphql variable binding in PR babysit (enables gh plate pr babysit + local-rebase strategy)

entries.summary: gh api graphql calls for babysit were using unsupported 'variables[foo]' field syntax, causing 'Variable $owner ... invalid value' and preventing load of review threads / mergeStateStatus. Switched to top-level fields (owner/repo/number, threadId) which gh CLI binds automatically to $vars for graphql queries/mutations.
entries.migration_impact: No action for downstream repos. This is a tool fix in plate-core / gh-plate extension. After upgrade, `gh plate pr babysit <n> --act --branch-update-strategy local-rebase` (and copilot-request) will work reliably for detecting out-of-sync and actionable agent review threads.
entries.agent_notes: Babysit loop (local or via gh plate) can now be used to keep PRs in sync and resolve third-party feedback without manual workarounds. The local-rebase impl (worktree + rebase + force-with-lease) is now exercisable end-to-end via the CLI. Update any docs referencing babysit if they noted 'broken'.
